name: NISTATIN 100000UI POWDER FOR SUSPENSION 24 ML 1 PIECE
description: Nystatin, in 100,000 IU/ml powder for oral suspension, is used to treat oral and intestinal candidiasis caused by the fungus Candida albicans. The user should prepare it before use, following the specific product instructions. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
